headline: Freedom Broker Upgrades Norwegian Cruise Line on Strong Q3 Results
summary: Freedom Broker upgraded its stock rating for Norwegian Cruise Line following the company's strong third-quarter financial results.
why: Brokerage rating upgrades based on quarterly performance metrics can drive institutional interest and trading volume for travel and leisure equities.

impacts.name: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd
impacts.why: An analyst upgrade supported by solid Q3 results improves the equity's market perception.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
